# Getting support

Please search the existing issues before opening a new one.

* **Questions about a specific ontology** (its terms, their meaning, how to use them): open an issue in the repository of that ontology, i.e. `https://github.com/SPAROntologies/<lowercase ontology acronym>`.
* **General questions** about the SPAR Ontologies, the [website](http://www.sparontologies.net), or the [contributing guidelines](CONTRIBUTING.md): open an issue in the [sparontologies.github.io repository](https://github.com/sparontologies/sparontologies.github.io/issues).
* **Proposals for a new ontology**: follow the process described in [Proposing a new ontology](CONTRIBUTING.md#proposing-a-new-ontology).
